ups-amazon-glide-down.n: UPS Amazon cutback and network overhaul
ups-amazon-glide-down.s: UPS has finished cutting Amazon volume and reconfiguring its network after announcing job cuts and building closures.

fedex-freight-spin.s: FedEx has named leaders for the Freight spin-off, which was on track for June 2026.

fedex-network-2.s: FedEx merged its Ground and Express pickup and delivery operations under Network 2.0, building on its merger into one company and DRIVE savings.

usps-air-cargo.s: UPS took over USPS domestic air cargo from FedEx as the FedEx contract expired.

ups-usps-handoff.s: UPS ended SurePost and Ground Saver handoffs to USPS and now makes those deliveries itself.

de-minimis.s: De minimis has ended for all countries, and carriers report a trade hit while postal services suspended U.S. shipments.

tariff-refunds.s: CBP has started processing tariff refunds, and FedEx, UPS and DHL have begun passing them to customers.

carrier-gri.s: FedEx set a 5.9% increase for Jan. 4, 2027 and DHL set 5.9% for Jan. 1, while UPS has not yet announced its 2027 rates.

usps-pricing.s: USPS has put holiday package prices into effect after a series of annual and mid-year increases.

peak-surcharges.s: Peak surcharges are now in effect on oversize packages, with home delivery surcharges due Oct. 24 to 26 and USPS holiday prices live.

import-export-fees.s: FedEx added per-pound demand fees on U.S. imports and raised export fees, following UPS's earlier surge fees.

usps-leadership.s: A report says the Postmaster General has told associates he wants to resign, after Steiner succeeded DeJoy and Tulino.

usps-service-network.s: USPS has lengthened delivery standards for Hawaii, following the 2025 standards changes and the consolidation pause.

usps-finances.s: The PRC says USPS package volume fell 6% in fiscal 2025 while package revenue held flat, after a $9.5 billion fiscal 2024 loss.

parcel-volume-amazon.n: U.S. parcel volume and Amazon's rise
parcel-volume-amazon.s: Amazon is now the largest U.S. carrier by volume, in a market of about 23 to 24 billion parcels in 2025.

usps-big-shipper-deals.s: USPS signed an exclusive last-mile deal with DHL eCommerce and is piloting same-day delivery for Amazon.

amazon-network-buildout.s: Amazon is extending its own delivery and logistics network, and local reports now describe new delivery stations in western North Dakota.

drone-delivery.s: Wing and Walmart plan to add Denver and Seattle in 2027, while FAA Part 108 remains unpublished and the FCC vote on drone use of the 800 MHz band is set for Oct. 29.

amazon-labor.s: An NLRB judge approved an Amazon DSP settlement without a joint-employer finding, and former drivers have sued Amazon and a closed contractor.
